description.value: Cockney Kings is a family-owned fish and chips institution that has been serving classic English-style fish and chips across Metro Vancouver since 1965. The Kitsilano location on Cornwall Avenue — steps from the Seaside Greenway cycling route — opened in 2023 and offers dine-in and takeout of battered fish, chips, and a full seafood menu. Now with four locations across Vancouver, Burnaby, and New Westminster, it remains a multi-generational local landmark.
